subject: Request: open backfill for Senior Inference Orchestration Engineer
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie (HiringProx) <sophie@hiringprox.com>, HiringProx Talent <talent@hiringprox.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: open backfill for Senior Inference Orchestration Engineer

Hi Marcus / Laura / Monica,

Requesting approval to open a backfill req for a Senior Inference Orchestration Engineer (individual contributor, IC4) on the Serving & Runtime team. This is a direct backfill for a departure on 11/30 — role owns scheduling/orchestration layer for model routing, KV cache management, and runtime batching policies.

Why now:
- Operational gap: the team must own a small set of SLO-critical code paths that are currently single-threaded to one engineer; leaving this open will increase mean-time-to-restore for region failovers.
- Impact: will unblock two active rollouts (dedicated pool autoscale and cross-region fallback) with estimated latency gains of 6–12% at P50.

Proposed details:
- Title / level: Senior Inference Orchestration Engineer (IC4)
- Band: M3/Senior (target comp range attached)
- Hiring timeline: post req opening, aim to interview in 2–3 weeks, offer within 5 weeks
- Interview loop: short take-home (design + perf microbenchmark), panel onsite/virtual 4–5 people (runtime engineer, infra SRE, product PM, security reviewer). Suggested interviewers: Markus Klein, Priyom Das, Monica Patel.

Attachments: JD-Sr-Inference-Orchestration.pdf, team-org.png, salary-band.xlsx (attached).

Asks:
1) Approval to create the req in Greenhouse and start external outreach via HiringProx.
2) Confirmation of interview panel and target salary band.
3) Marcus: any objections on org/headcount or cost center?

If approved I will ask Recruiting to raise the req and circulate the panel scheduling options next week.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Engineering Manager, Serving & Runtime
Redwood Inference

--- Attachments: JD-Sr-Inference-Orchestration.pdf (PDF, 28KB); team-org.png (PNG, 45KB); salary-band.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: open backfill for Senior Inference Orchestration Engineer

Rachel — thanks for the quick brief. Approve in principle to open the req and engage HiringProx. A few conditions before we post publicly:
- Tighten must-haves to include distributed systems + production tracing/debugging + on-call ownership. We need folks who can own the KV cache/eviction story end-to-end.
- Please add the cost center and confirm existing headcount vs. replaced headcount (I assume this is 1-for-1).
- Agree the interview loop and interviewers, but add a short systems-design whiteboard focused on latency regression scenarios.

If those updates are added to the job brief I greenlight creating the req. Marcus
